salitre.nota:
**A2-E03 · Salt's.** “The road dies at a closed shipyard, rusted cranes cut out against a slate-colored sky. By the gate there's a bar with a neon sign missing a letter: SAL 'S. Inside are scarred wooden tables, a bar built from the split hull of a boat, and black-and-white photos of strikes.” The sign is a “neon” light on the façade (it isn't painted: there's no text on the map). Rosa waits with her elbows on the **bar** and a welding torch on top of it (tile or token).

**The barroom.** Open to the mortal public until two. The **bar** is half the shell of a boat's hull, with the bottle shelf behind it; the **strike photos** hang on the north and south walls. Tables, chairs, and stools are movable (tiles): a dozen Anarchs use them as cover if things break (Combat: Rosa stops it on the second round, “Not here.”). Tavi Mercer (MEN-05) never looks away from them.

**The back room.** A meeting table (the assembly votes on whether to help the coterie) and a cork board with clippings: that's where Rosa keeps her 1996 clipping (AYU-04: “if it comes up in A2-E03, let her be the one to take it out”). It's the place for the confession to David “alone.” The door opens onto the barroom, on the public side; another door leads to the storeroom.

**The back.** Bas Okonjo hides in the **storeroom** (kegs, the keg cooler) so Hal won't see him; the **back door** opens onto the shipyard yard. Hal can talk to him alone there.

**The shipyard.** The sliding gate closes off the road; the bar sits outside, right up against it. Inside is the **head of the slipway**: it's lined up with the road, and from there you can see any car coming down the only road (the Anarchs' lookout). The slipway continues toward the water, to the north, off the map; the **three hulls in dry dock** (Salt's havens, Rosa's among them; Ray Dorsey slept there in 1996) are the shipyard exterior (t2i): regions with no destination.

**Escape.** Nobody holds them back: the bar door opens onto the road.
